 Medium

 Print Accident logo Jalandhar : Two teenagers died early Sunday morning after their car struck a municipal tractor-trailer near a major roundabout while returning from a birthday celebration. Police identified the deceased as Divit Aulack (18), son of Speed Records founder Dinesh Aulack and nephew of renowned singer Yo Yo Honey Singh , and Aarav Talwar, (19), whose family owns multiple sweet shop outlets in Jalandhar. Three other occupants sustained minor injuries and were discharged after treatment. Watch Honey Singh Joins BJP Punjab Campaign Against Drugs, Meets Tarun Chugh Police received a control room alert around 3am and dispatched teams to the site. Both victims were taken to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared them brought dead. Baradari police station SHO Sahil Chaudhary said preliminary investigations indicated the car rammed into a municipal corporation tractor-trailer engaged in road garbage collection. The bodies were handed over to the families, who declined to file a legal complaint.
